unit.why: A single anecdote: the Seer of Lublin orders the narrator's great-grandfather to build a stone house, and the instruction miraculously brings him income.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מאבי זקניר׳ צבי זצ"ל בילדותו
stories.end_quote: הג׳ מאות ר״ט נשארו לו במזומן
stories.summary_en: R. Zvi, the narrator's great-grandfather, has only 300 roubles and asks the Seer of Lublin for livelihood advice; despite ridicule he obeys the order to build a stone house, finds limestone while digging, sells it at a profit, builds the house and keeps his 300 roubles.

ונסע להרבי זצ״ל מלובלין לישאל לו עצה
